name: env-ref-missing
description: A ${ENV:NAME} placeholder referencing an unset variable fails loudly, naming the variable.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
    vars:
      token: ${ENV:ATOMYX_CORPUS_TOKEN_UNSET}
